title: A harness that reports no usage: every figure estimated
covers: fresh by cost, near the band
estimates: C0 from characters, K 0.9 W, B 25,000, R from characters
brief: Today is {{TODAY}}. Harness: a generic agent harness calling the Anthropic API. The harness reports this session's model as claude-sonnet-5-5 at effort medium, and reports no token usage at all.
The model's documentation gives a context window of 200,000 tokens; the harness documents no compaction point. This session has not been compacted.
Still in context: a system prompt and tool definitions of 80,000 characters of prose, and messages and tool results of 220,000 characters of prose and 140,000 characters of code.
No baseline has been measured for a fresh session in this harness and project.
Next stage: a refactor within one module, with its test suite as the oracle. Plan estimate: 30 turns. No per-turn measurement exists.
A fresh session would read the handoff (10,000 characters) and the module's files (70,000 characters).
A handoff for this stage would be about 80 lines.
Everything this session knows that the next stage needs is already written in files on disk.
No cache-miss measurement exists, and no review pauses are expected during the stage.
The stage writes files and commits locally; nothing leaves the machine.
notes: The margin is about 12 percent: an input read wrongly can move the verdict into the band, which is what this scenario is for.
